auto_classification_rules.condition: Expert source with clear product opinion
auto_classification_rules.reason: Expert opinion directly relevant to scoring

auto_classification_rules.condition: Published review with specs or testing data
auto_classification_rules.reason: Review with verifiable data supports scoring

auto_classification_rules.condition: Forum post describing physical product defect with corroborating pattern
auto_classification_rules.reason: Corroborated defect pattern is scoring evidence

auto_classification_rules.condition: Forum post about sales process, dealer experience, customer service
auto_classification_rules.reason: Service experience feeds Warranty Reality and Serviceability, not axis scores

auto_classification_rules.condition: Single forum complaint with no corroboration
auto_classification_rules.reason: Uncorroborated single complaint does not meet evidence threshold

auto_classification_rules.condition: Source about a different product line from same manufacturer
auto_classification_rules.reason: Wrong product line — not applicable to this evaluation

auto_classification_rules.condition: Source about installation quality, not product quality
auto_classification_rules.reason: Installation is separate from product quality scoring

auto_classification_rules.condition: Manufacturer marketing content with no independent value
auto_classification_rules.reason: Marketing content is not independent evidence

auto_classification_rules.condition: Legal/lawsuit information about this specific product's defect
auto_classification_rules.reason: Product-specific legal action is direct scoring evidence
Company-level legal info feeds context but not product axis scores

S.description: Known expert comparison sources with structured scoring

A.description: Credentialed professionals, trade publications, independent testing

B.description: Published reviews, dealer content, sponsored but knowledgeable sources

C.description: Individual forum posts, Reddit comments, Houzz threads, BBB complaints
